def factor_asymmetric_impact_crowding_adj(df):
    """Asymmetric price impact modulated by volume-range crowding."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy['close'].pct_change()
    dollar_vol = (df_copy['close'] * df_copy['volume']).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    pos_impact = (ret.where(ret > 0, np.nan).abs() / dollar_vol)
    neg_impact = (ret.where(ret < 0, np.nan).abs() / dollar_vol)
    pos_mean = pos_impact.rolling(20, min_periods=5).mean()
    neg_mean = neg_impact.rolling(20, min_periods=5).mean()
    raw_asym = pos_mean - neg_mean
    prev_close = df_copy['close'].shift(1)
    true_range = np.maximum(df_copy['high'] - df_copy['low'],
                            np.maximum((df_copy['high'] - prev_close).abs(),
                                       (df_copy['low'] - prev_close).abs()))
    log_range = np.log(true_range.replace(0, np.nan).clip(lower=1e-12))
    log_volume = np.log(df_copy['volume'].clip(lower=1e-12))
    crowding_corr = log_range.rolling(20, min_periods=10).corr(log_volume)
    weight = 0.8 + 0.4 * crowding_corr.fillna(0.0)
    factor = raw_asym * weight
    df_copy['factor_asymmetric_impact_crowding_adj'] = factor
    return df_copy['factor_asymmetric_impact_crowding_adj']
description: Primary mechanism from alpha-liquidity-0001: asymmetric price impact between up and down days captures liquidity supply imbalance. Borrowed lightweight idea from ahern_crowding_range_vol_corr_001: rolling correlation between log true range and log volume indicates crowding/volume concentration. A bounded weight based on this correlation amplifies the signal when volume concentrates on high-volatility bars (herding), while preserving continuous cross-sectional variation. This modulation targets improved IC and MI without disturbing the stable RankICIR and payoff profile.
